title: Why Foil Peels Off After Stamping

seo.title: Why Foil Peels Off After Stamping

content:
Hot stamping durability depends on the foil grade, paper surface and machine setting.

## Main Point

A foil may transfer visually but still perform poorly if it does not match the top surface. Printed paper, varnished paper and laminated paper should be checked separately.

## Practical Check

Compare the same foil on plain paper and on the final production sheet. If only the production sheet has weak performance, the surface match should be reviewed.

## What to Check

Review rub resistance and folding performance after stamping. Do not approve the foil only by fresh appearance.

## FAQ

### Is one paper foil suitable for every surface?

No. Coated and laminated surfaces often need specific grades.

## Sample Support

Send your paper sample. We can recommend suitable foil options for testing.
